skill_outcomes.outcome_description: Understand the general theoretical issues of social security law: concepts, characteristics of social security and social security law; objects regulated, methods of regulation, sources of law and principles of social security law; social security legal relations; History of formation and development of Vietnamese social security law.
Understand the basic contents of social security law: Social Insurance, Unemployment Insurance, Health Insurance, Social Benefits, Social Assistance; Resolving social security disputes.
Apply skills to resolve legal situations related to social security effectively.
Develop self-study skills to accumulate and enhance knowledge and experience in social security law.
Be proactive in presenting research results.
